snippet.title: SACRED: Last Pixel of Ancaria - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The new Sacred game is announced! Now in pixel art approaches.

Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria will begin it's Kickstarter campaign in 14 April 2026.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sparklingbit/sacred-last-pixel-of-ancaria

Developer: SparklingBit

#Sacred #actionrpg #pixelart
